methods.bind_player: Assign a stable, game-owned player ID to an admitted peer in the authority lobby. The caller supplies the verified identity. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.configure: Create a new GameDefinition with the same defaults as a definition created in the Inspector.
methods.declare_command: Declare a command name on a guest. Match the authority's requires_primary setting. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.get_local_character_id: Return the local player's current primary character ID, or an empty string when no primary is available.
methods.get_local_player: Return the spawned player node for this peer in an immediate-play game, or null when there is no local player.
methods.get_local_player_id: Return the game-owned player ID for this peer, or an empty string when no local binding is available.
methods.get_online_listing: Return the current provider listing ID, or an empty string when the game has no active listing.
methods.get_phase: Return the current Phase value. Listen to phase_changed to observe transitions.
methods.get_player: Return the spawned player node for peer_id in an immediate-play game, or null when that peer has no mounted player.
methods.get_projection: Return a detached copy of this guest's visible replicated records. Read it after projection_updated. The authority's internal command context is omitted.
methods.get_world: Return the currently mounted world root, or null when no world is mounted. Reacquire the node after travel, restore, or teardown.
methods.get_world_epoch: Return the epoch of the published world. Epochs distinguish successive activations, including visits to the same world ID.
methods.get_world_id: Return the last published world ID. Wait for world_ready before using it as the active playable destination.
methods.host: Open a coordinated lobby on the session's selected transport, ENet by default. max_clients counts guests. With ENet, port is the UDP port and * binds all interfaces. A successful return opens the lobby for admission and player binding before start_match.
methods.host_game: Start a direct-address listen game with the configured starting scene and player. The operation succeeds after the world and local player are ready and the host can admit guests. Use * to bind all interfaces.
methods.host_online: Start a listen game using the configured provider. Supply the advertised address, or an empty string for a provider that supplies a route. The operation completes after the world is ready and the provider publishes its listing.
methods.is_authority: Return whether this game instance currently owns session authority, including when playing offline.
methods.join: Begin joining a coordinated lobby through the session's selected transport. With ENet, supply the host address and UDP port. timeout_seconds bounds connection time. OK means the attempt started. Observe phase_changed and session_ended for the outcome.
methods.join_game: Connect to a direct-address game using the configured UDP port. Await the operation for scene and roster readiness and placement of the local player.
methods.join_online: Resolve listing_id through the configured provider and join the resulting game. The operation succeeds after admission, world synchronization, and local player readiness.
methods.leave: Cancel pending startup or begin releasing the active transport, match, and mounted world. Observe session_ended after leaving an active session. If cancelling an online lookup before the session starts, observe the startup operation. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.open_offline: Open a local authority lobby. Use it before restore to continue from a menu without loading the default world first. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.play_solo: Mount the configured starting scene and spawn the local player in an offline game. Await the operation before accessing the mounted world or player.
methods.register_command: Register an authority-side handler for a command name. The handler receives the trusted player ID and the intent dictionary. Set requires_primary to require a current primary character assignment. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.save_history: Read up to limit generations from a known profile and slot, newest first. Supply both before_sequence and before_id to continue from an exclusive cursor. A successful result includes rows in value, the slot status, a truncated flag, and a next cursor when more rows exist.
methods.set_shared_stores: Set the store IDs whose complete records can be published to every bound guest. The default view exposes no shared stores. A custom projector takes precedence. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.start_dedicated: Mount the starting world as a dedicated direct-address authority. All configured player seats are available to guests. Await the operation for world and admission readiness.
methods.start_dedicated_online: Mount a playerless authority world and publish it through the configured online provider. Supply the advertised address, or an empty string for a provider-managed route. Await the operation for listing and world readiness.
methods.submit: Submit a declared gameplay command and a plain dictionary payload from a ready participant. The returned operation reports the authority's command result. Observe projection_updated separately for visible state changes.

signals.peer_joined: Emitted when a peer joins the coordinated session roster. The authority can then bind the admitted connection to a verified player ID.
signals.peer_left: Emitted when a peer leaves the coordinated session roster. The departed peer's binding and readiness are retired.
signals.phase_changed: Emitted when the game changes Phase. The argument is the new phase.
signals.projection_updated: Emitted after a guest applies a visible projection at revision. baseline is true when the update establishes a new baseline. Read get_projection to obtain the applied view.
signals.session_ended: Emitted after the game releases session resources. The reason identifies what ended the session.
signals.world_ready: Emitted when a world with the given ID and epoch is ready for play. Coordinated network games wait for required scene and baseline acknowledgments.

constants.IDLE: No active game session. An online listing lookup may still be pending.
constants.LOBBY: A coordinated session is open and the first world is pending.
constants.TRANSITIONING: A world startup, travel, or restore is in progress.
constants.RUNNING: The published world is ready for play.
constants.RECOVERING: A failure after publication closed command admission. Leave the game before starting a new session.

GameServices.description: Static lookups for active GameRuntime scopes and their scene services.

methods.for_node: Find the active game whose subtree contains node. Returns null if no active game owns that node.
methods.game: Return the explicitly selected default game or the only active game. Returns null if no game can be selected unambiguously.
methods.scenes: Return the SceneService of the default game, or null if there is no default game.
methods.set_default_game: Select an active GameRuntime as the default for game and scenes. Pass null to clear the explicit selection. Returns a Godot Error.

InventoryTransactionAdapter.description: Registers a SpatialInventory snapshot as an authority store so grid edits can commit atomically with other gameplay changes.

methods.configure: Validate the initial SpatialInventory snapshot and register it under store_id in the supplied coordinator. Returns a Godot Error.
methods.get_snapshot: Return the currently committed snapshot in SpatialInventory format, or an empty dictionary before configuration.
methods.queue_move: Queue an existing item's new grid origin and rotation in a transaction owned by the configured coordinator. Returns a Godot Error. The inventory changes on a successful commit.
methods.queue_place: Queue placement of a new item with the given footprint, grid origin, and rotation. Returns a Godot Error. The authority validates the placement when the transaction commits.
methods.queue_remove: Queue removal of item_id in a transaction owned by the configured coordinator. Returns a Godot Error. The inventory changes on a successful commit.

OnlineDirectory.description: Implement this Resource in a custom game provider to publish and resolve playable listings. Complete directory requests on the scene thread.

methods._leave: Release local membership for listing_id when a resolved join ends or is abandoned. Handle lookups that failed or were still pending.
methods._publish: Publish the authority's mounted world. Use endpoint as the advertised route when supplied, or obtain the route from the provider's transport. Complete request with publish or fail.
methods._resolve: Look up listing_id and complete request with a SessionEndpoint that the chosen transport accepts. Call fail when the listing cannot be resolved.
methods._unpublish: Retire the listing the provider created under listing_id. Release any external listing state when the provider shuts down.

OnlineDirectoryRequest.description: One completion handle supplied to a provider for publishing a listing or resolving a route. Complete it on the scene thread. The game cancels pending requests on timeout or teardown.

methods.fail: Finish a pending directory request with no listing or endpoint. Returns a Godot Error if the request can no longer accept completion.
methods.is_cancelled: Return true after the game cancels or abandons this request. Use it to release provider resources.
methods.publish: Complete a publication with a unique listing ID. If completion arrives after cancellation, the request attempts to retire the listing. If it returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE, the provider must remove the external listing itself.
methods.resolve: Complete a lookup with a non-null endpoint for the selected transport. Returns a Godot Error when the request is invalid or no longer pending.

SceneService.description: A scene handle scoped to the GameRuntime that created it. Use it to load a registered world through the game's normal transition lifecycle.

methods.get_world: Return the mounted world from the originating game scope, or null if the scope is retired or no world is mounted.
methods.load: Request authority travel to a registered world ID. Await the returned GameOperation to observe the outcome, including when the originating game scope has retired.
